name: Delete R2 catalog metadata
description: Delete R2 catalog metadata Removes the catalog from the control plane without deleting R2 bucket objects. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/delete
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/delete
Removes the catalog from the control plane without deleting R2 bucket objects. Set force=true to remove catalog namespaces, tables, views, and maintenance metadata. Force deletion is limited to a configured catalog object count.
Required: account_id (path); bucket_name (path)
Optional: force (query) — Remove child metadata before deleting the catalog.

name: Disable R2 catalog
description: Disable R2 catalog Disable an R2 bucket as a catalog. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/disable
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/disable
Disable an R2 bucket as a catalog. This operation deactivates the catalog but preserves existing metadata and data files. The catalog can be re-enabled later.
Required: account_id (path) — Identifies the account.; bucket_name (path) — Specifies the R2 bucket name to disable as catalog.

name: Enable R2 bucket as a catalog
description: Enable R2 bucket as a catalog Enable an R2 bucket as an Apache Iceberg catalog. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/enable
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/enable
Enable an R2 bucket as an Apache Iceberg catalog. This operation creates the necessary catalog infrastructure and activates the bucket for storing Iceberg metadata and data files.
Required: account_id (path) — Identifies the account.; bucket_name (path) — Specifies the R2 bucket name to enable as catalog.

name: Get R2 catalog details
description: Get R2 catalog details Retrieve detailed information about a specific R2 catalog by bucket name. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}

name: Get catalog maintenance configuration
description: Get catalog maintenance configuration Retrieve the maintenance configuration for a specific catalog, including compaction settings and credential status. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/maintenance-configs
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/maintenance-configs
Retrieve the maintenance configuration for a specific catalog, including compaction settings and credential status.
Required: account_id (path) — Identifies the account.; bucket_name (path) — Specifies the R2 bucket name.

name: Get table details
description: Get table details Returns full Apache Iceberg metadata for a single table: schema, partition specs, sort orders, properties, and recent snapshot history. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/namespaces/{namespace}/tables/{table_name}

name: Get table maintenance configuration
description: Get table maintenance configuration Retrieve the maintenance configuration for a specific table, including compaction settings. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/namespaces/{namespace}/tables/{table_name}/maintenance-configs
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/namespaces/{namespace}/tables/{table_name}/maintenance-configs
Retrieve the maintenance configuration for a specific table, including compaction settings.
Required: account_id (path) — Identifies the account.; bucket_name (path) — Specifies the R2 bucket name.; namespace (path) — The namespace identifier (use %1F as separator for nested namespaces).; table_name (path) — The table name.

name: List R2 catalogs
description: List R2 catalogs Returns a list of R2 buckets that have been enabled as Apache Iceberg catalogs for the specified account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog
Returns a list of R2 buckets that have been enabled as Apache Iceberg catalogs for the specified account. Each catalog represents an R2 bucket configured to store Iceberg metadata and data files.
Required: account_id (path) — Identifies the account.

name: List namespaces in catalog
description: List namespaces in catalog Returns a list of namespaces in the specified R2 catalog. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/namespaces
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/namespaces
Returns a list of namespaces in the specified R2 catalog. Supports hierarchical filtering and pagination for efficient traversal of large namespace hierarchies.
Required: account_id (path) — Identifies the account.; bucket_name (path) — Specifies the R2 bucket name.
Optional: page_token (query) — Opaque pagination token from a previous response. Use this to fetch the next page of results.; page_size (query) — Maximum number of namespaces to return per page. Defaults to 100, maximum 1000.; parent (query) — Parent namespace to filter by. Only returns direct children of this namespace. For nested namespaces, use %1F as separator (e.g., "bronze%1Fanalytics"). Omit this parameter to list top-level namespaces.; return_uuids (query) — Whether to include namespace UUIDs in the response. Set to true to receive the namespace_uuids array.; return_details (query) — Whether to include additional metadata (timestamps). When true, response includes created_at and updated_at arrays.

name: List table maintenance runs
description: List table maintenance runs Retrieves recent table maintenance runs for the current table. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/namespaces/{namespace}/tables/{table_name}/maintenance-runs
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/namespaces/{namespace}/tables/{table_name}/maintenance-runs
Retrieves recent table maintenance runs for the current table.
Required: account_id (path); bucket_name (path); namespace (path); table_name (path)
Optional: page_size (query); page_token (query)

name: List tables in namespace
description: List tables in namespace Returns a list of tables in the specified namespace within an R2 catalog. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/namespaces/{namespace}/tables
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/namespaces/{namespace}/tables
Returns a list of tables in the specified namespace within an R2 catalog. Supports pagination for efficient traversal of large table collections.
Required: account_id (path) — Identifies the account.; bucket_name (path) — Specifies the R2 bucket name.; namespace (path) — The namespace identifier. For nested namespaces, use %1F as separator (e.g., "bronze%1Fanalytics").
Optional: page_token (query) — Opaque pagination token from a previous response. Use this to fetch the next page of results.; page_size (query) — Maximum number of tables to return per page. Defaults to 100, maximum 1000.; return_uuids (query) — Whether to include table UUIDs in the response. Set to true to receive the table_uuids array.; return_details (query) — Whether to include additional metadata (timestamps, locations). When true, response includes created_at, updated_at, metadata_locations, and locations arrays.

name: Queue table maintenance
description: Queue table maintenance Queue maintenance for normal polling. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/namespaces/{namespace}/tables/{table_name}/maintenance-configs/{configuration_type}/queue
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/namespaces/{namespace}/tables/{table_name}/maintenance-configs/{configuration_type}/queue
Queue maintenance for normal polling. This request does not start a run.
Required: account_id (path); bucket_name (path); namespace (path); table_name (path); configuration_type (path); body (body)

name: Store catalog credentials
description: Store catalog credentials Store authentication credentials for a catalog. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/credential
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/credential
Store authentication credentials for a catalog. These credentials are used to authenticate with R2 storage when performing catalog operations.
Required: account_id (path) — Identifies the account.; bucket_name (path) — Specifies the R2 bucket name.; body (body)

name: Update catalog maintenance configuration
description: Update catalog maintenance configuration Update the maintenance configuration for a catalog. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/maintenance-configs
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/maintenance-configs
Update the maintenance configuration for a catalog. This allows you to enable or disable compaction and adjust target file sizes for optimization.
Required: account_id (path) — Identifies the account.; bucket_name (path) — Specifies the R2 bucket name.; body (body)

name: Update table maintenance configuration
description: Update table maintenance configuration Update the maintenance configuration for a specific table. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/namespaces/{namespace}/tables/{table_name}/maintenance-configs
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/r2-catalog/{bucket_name}/namespaces/{namespace}/tables/{table_name}/maintenance-configs
Update the maintenance configuration for a specific table. This allows you to enable or disable compaction and adjust target file sizes for optimization.
Required: account_id (path) — Identifies the account.; bucket_name (path) — Specifies the R2 bucket name.; namespace (path) — The namespace identifier (use %1F as separator for nested namespaces).; table_name (path) — The table name.; body (body)
